commands:
set -eu
repo=/home/admin/hftbacktest-cross-exchange-0726T068R1
outbase=/home/admin/hftbacktest-cross-exchange-artifacts/0726T068R1_no_order_preflight
printf 'UTC=%s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
test "$(cat "$repo/source_commit.txt")" = a0bc92898ecea43cbdc4219efc1acbcd69580969
test "$(systemctl is-active xemm.service || true)" = inactive
runuser -u admin -- flock -n /tmp/hftbacktest_live_test.lock -c true
if ps -eo pid=,comm=,args= | awk '$2 ~ /^python/ && $0 ~ /(hyperliquid_tiny_live_m2_public_watcher|cross_exchange_live_remote_orchestrator|cross_exchange_public_collector)/ {print; found=1} END {exit found ? 0 : 1}'; then
  echo LIVE_PYTHON_PROCESS_FOUND >&2
  exit 1
fi
for n in 1 2 3; do
  file="$outbase/window_$(printf '%02d' "$n")/orchestrator_preflight.json"
  test "$(sha256sum "$file" | awk '{print $1}')" = "$(awk '{print $1}' "$outbase/window_$(printf '%02d' "$n")/orchestrator_preflight.sha256")"
  jq -e --argjson n "$n" --argjson offset "$((n-1))" '.artifact_identity.window_ids==[$n] and .envelope.window_id_offset==$offset and .execution_boundary.credential_file_read==false and .execution_boundary.watcher_process_started==false and .execution_boundary.private_endpoint_called==false and .execution_boundary.order_endpoint_called==false and .execution_boundary.cancel_endpoint_called==false' "$file" >/dev/null
done
echo XEMM=inactive
echo LIVE_PYTHON_PROCESSES=0
echo LOCK_HOLDER=0
echo PRIVATE_ACCOUNT_ORDER_CANCEL_ACTIONS=0
echo T068R1_FINAL_NO_ORDER_ASSERTION_PASS
